findings.antecedent: Visually viewed first target on ground plane (width condition)
findings.mechanism: near-linear walking performance despite small undershoot
findings.quote: in the width condition, the mean signed error was -27 cm (undershoot) and the mean absolute error was 57 cm

findings.antecedent: Visually viewed first target on ground plane (depth condition)
findings.mechanism: near-linear walking performance despite small undershoot
findings.quote: in the depth condition, the mean signed error was -50 cm (undershoot) and the mean absolute error was 74 cm.

findings.antecedent: Visually viewed frontal or sagittal interval
findings.mechanism: systematic overshoot in walked interval length
findings.quote: the mean intervals were on the average about 50 cm larger than the corresponding physical intervals

findings.antecedent: Visually viewed frontal vs. sagittal intervals
findings.consequent: Ratio of walked width interval to walked depth interval
findings.mechanism: visually directed action does not manifest perceptual anisotropy, except for smallest interval size
findings.quote: walking to two targets does not manifest this anisotropy, although there is some anisotropy in the reverse direction for the smallest interval size.

findings.antecedent: Previously viewed target while walking blindly past it
findings.mechanism: accurate imaginal updating of internal spatial representation
findings.quote: the mean pointing direction nearly coincides with that of the target for all three paths

findings.antecedent: Previously viewed target while walking blindly past it (100-cm nearest approach path)
findings.consequent: Angular velocity of arm during continuous pointing
findings.mechanism: dynamic updating of target location, not preprogrammed
findings.quote: the angular velocity of the arm (...) changes systematically during the trav- erse in accord with the true target azimuth.

stimuli.description: white steel rods (16cm high, 1cm diameter) on a grassy field, defining frontal and depth intervals.
red neon lamp target in a lightproof warehouse, with masking tape paths.
